Units from the client's <refinementWindow><update><items>: laser rounds, rocket count, engine/shield minutes; 1 ore = 10 rounds/units/minutes (unit, per part; official Resources FAQ: Prometid 10 units, Duranium 10 minutes; wiki '1 ore for 10 shots'; user report 2026-10-24: 1 Seprom gave 1 shot; on 2026-10-28 engine/shield was set to 1 minute, on 2026-10-31 it was reverted to 10 minutes), at most 1,000,000 units per part (maximum; Team DarkOrbit 2019: nothing is added to a part that exceeded the cap, the leftover ore stays in cargo). Engine minutes are spent while moving, shield minutes in combat (adaptation). Upgrading with another ore erases the previous one (client: lab_alert).

heat._source: wiki (P.E.T. HEAT): wiki thresholds 150/300/450/600/750 (the "100" in the 5th row is a typo), bonuses accumulate, cooling delays 12 h/24 h/24 h/15 min/5 min, 7 HEAT slots (laser or shield generator) active from the 4th level, LF-PX01/SG3N-PX01 +0.5/1/2/4/8% by HEAT level. Real recording (20261025_152841_gercek, PetHeatUpdateCommand): at level 0 petHeatAmountMax 75 (the bar max is the next threshold) and the active P.E.T. gains +1.8957 per minute (no difference seen in combat: combat_gain_sec 0); since the recording shows only level 0, the thresholds are half of the wiki's 150/300/450/600/750 (75/150/225/300/375; assumption, a session recording that skips HEAT levels is needed). The AI-AH protocol raises the gain; after the delay ends it cools 0.5 points per second, and when it drops to a lower level that level's delay starts. Bonuses go to the ship while the P.E.T. is in space; the HP bonus goes to the P.E.T.'s own HP (recording: the max HP of level 20 P.E.T.s (50,000 + G-HP1) x1.10 / x1.20, x1.14 with AI-HP; E5).

hp_upgrade._source: wiki (P.E.T. level table MAX HP / HP UPGRADE): each upgrade +10,000 HP; as many upgrades as the P.E.T. level (level 20: 250,000); the price of the n-th upgrade is the n-th row of the table. G-HP1 in the shop (client: pet_upgrade-g-hp1, buy_pet_hull).

pet.fuel_formula: Per-minute consumption from the level table (real recording: level 7 = 33, 13 = 44). The formula '1 + 2 x level + 2 x protocol + 4 x gear' of official forum 127074 always gives an odd number and cannot produce the recording's 44: not applied. Multipliers: fuel protocol, Combo Protection, active beacon/HP Link x1.3, +5% per heat level (forum: 'more fuel at high heat'; rate is an adaptation)

_pet_source: belgeler/wiki/drones_pet.md (wiki). P.E.T.-10 is 50,000 U in the shop (ShopItemListCommand 'pet' in the recording). HP 50,000: the max HP of the level 13 P.E.T. in the recording is 55,000 (the wiki's up to 250,000 HP comes from purchased upgrades; not on the server). Max fuel 100,000 and the level thresholds (petExperiencePointsUntilNextLevel = the next level's total EP) from the recording. Ship type by level from the client's game.xml (12: 1-3, 13: 4-6, 14: 7-9, 15: 10-12, 22: 13-15). Fuel use per minute: in the real recording a level 7 P.E.T. spends exactly 33 per minute (wiki table 53), in the earlier recording level 13 ~44 (wiki 75); the table is 0.6x the wiki values, these two levels from the recording (ESYA2). Level bonuses (damage/shield) are the wiki's even/odd level effects, not cumulative, the final value. Slots: laser, gear and protocol are as open as in the level table; the generator slot does not come with level (in the recording at level 7 maxGeneratorSlots 2, the 3rd slot 5,000 U): initial 2 + purchased; more are unlocked in the hangar by slot number with uridium (wiki prices). Hotkey fuel 1,000 units (the client's log_msg_bought_fuel_hotkey text), 250 U (real recording: -250 U without touching credits; wiki 0.25 U/unit). Aliens do not shoot the P.E.T. (in the real game only enemy players; user report 2026-10-24). After repair, HP is repair_hp of max (real recording: 3,500 / 70,000 = 5%; Kamikaze could not be used at full HP, user report 2026-10-24); the kamikaze threshold is an adaptation. Gears and protocols have 3 levels: price and effects are the level list (wiki); level 2 requires P.E.T. level 4, level 3 requires 8. For a hangar item level = level - 1 (the client shows level 1 as "Level: 0"). In protection mode the P.E.T. goes to near_distance next to the target; it does not fight an NPC farther than combat_distance from the ship (adaptation). E5: the 4th level of the protocols (wiki) requires P.E.T. level 20 (wiki "Access to fourth level equipment"); in the 4th tier of the recording's LevelDataList only AI-ECO is 105,000 U, the others 0 (client pet_gear_shop_level_limit: not bought from the shop). G-HR1 price from the recording (10,000 / 15,000 / 32,000). G-KK1 cooldown 120/60/30 s (wiki), not selectable on the starting maps (client message); threshold 0.2 adaptation, the ship's HP also triggers it (client "your P.E.T. or ship"). G-TRA1 sale bonus +5/15/30% (wiki, client "Trade bonus"); the amount of the trade's fuel cost is not given (not verified, not implemented). C-SR2's extra fuel is per repair (client "Uses extra fuel for each repair"; wiki 200/400/750).
_drone_designs_source: IDs are from the client's game.xml <drones><designs> list (the '0|n|d|…|type|level|design|appearance' fields in space). Slot from the client's DroneItem code: DroneDesignType 'design' (with bonus), DroneCustomizationType 'visual' (appearance only). Bonuses from the wiki (belgeler/wiki/drones_pet.md): per_drone for every drone with the design, set_bonus when all owned drones carry the same design (the client's Havoc text: 'If all of the drones are equipped'; the wiki says 10 drones). npc = damage to NPCs (laser and rocket). Champion country designs (drone-champion-*) and Champion are appearance only (wiki: Visual drone designs are cosmetic; Stage 5). E5: set bonuses from the client's texts: drone_laser applies only to the drones' lasers (Havoc "all of the drones will profit from a laser cannon efficiency bonus" 10%, Cerberus 5%, Inferno Cerberus "Laser Efficiency" 8%), cooldown is the cooldown of ship abilities (Archeron 8%, Inferno Cerberus 10%, Hermes 10%), Hermes mine, rocket and Hellstorm cooldown -10%, Lepus cannon damage +10% and cannon hit +5% (top, cannon_hit). Hermes's per-drone bonus (the client does not mention it) and the scope of Spartan's "damage and HP" (the server covers only lasers) are from the wiki, not verified. EVENT: per_event {event (calendar key), npc_laser}: a temporary NPC laser damage bonus from the appearance design, for each one worn while the event runs (profile.design_mods; darkorbitwiki Apocalypse Booty Box: legendary 0.6%, rare 0.3%, standard 0.2%).
